The accident occurred around 2.30 am when Jayabalakrishnan was going back home on his scooter after closing his thattukada (street food stall). The speeding car, identified as a Mercedes-Benz, rammed into his scooter from behind. Jayabalakrishnan’s family alleged that the teenager attempted to flee the scene after the collision but his car, which was impacted by the accident, stopped after a few metres. According to media reports, the car was registered under the name of the judge. Police told the media that the prima facie report did not indicate intoxication at the time of the accident. “Currently, we have registered a case against causing death by negligence. The boy was alone in the car at the time. Since he is a minor, we need to take advice from the Juvenile Justice Board to take further steps in this case,” Cheranallur CI Shyam Kumar said.
